_comment: Tier-1 mcp_tool source presets for salesforce-agent (AU-KG.ingest.mcp-tool-connector). Syncs Salesforce CRM objects into the KG as documents via the salesforce-agent MCP server's salesforce_soql tool. Contributed presets win over the central MCP_TOOL_PRESETS. The native typed-node path is salesforce_ingest_crm / salesforce_agent.kg_ingest.
